user.title: Add heating hub
user.description: A hub groups rooms that share profiles and rules (for example one hub per floor). The first profile in the list is the initial base profile. Add the integration again to create another hub.

data_description.comfort_temperature: Temperature for the `comfort` preset in schedules (default 21.5).

external.title: External temperature sensor
external.description: Choose the room's temperature sensor. The next steps assign the thermostat entities that receive the value.

data_description.min_change: Smaller changes are not sent, to spare the batteries.
data_description.min_interval: Never send more often than this.
data_description.heartbeat_minutes: Re-send the value regularly so the thermostat does not fall back to its own sensor. 0 disables it.
data_description.grace_minutes: How long the sensor may be unavailable before the fallback applies.
data_description.fallback: Switch the thermostats back to their internal sensor, or keep sending the last value.
data_description.remote_option: Value of the mode select that makes the thermostat use the external sensor (Sonoff TRVZB: remote_temperature).
data_description.local_option: Value that makes it use its own sensor again, used for the fallback (Sonoff TRVZB: local_temperature).

external_trv.title: Thermostat entities
external_trv.description: Entities of **{climate}** (auto-detected from the same device when possible).

data_description.number: The entity that receives the room temperature. Pre-selected when detected on the thermostat's device; change it for other thermostat models.
data_description.select: The entity that switches the thermostat between its internal and the external sensor. Leave empty if the thermostat has none; then only the temperature value is sent.

schedule.title: Schedule overrides
schedule.description: **{scope}** follows the hub's default schedule unless a day is overridden. Choose the profile.

schedule_day.title: Schedule overrides

edit_day_mon.title: Monday
edit_day_mon.description:
Scope: **{scope}**, profile **{profile}**. One line per switch point as `HH:MM temperature`; each temperature applies until the next line. The temperature is either a preset name (`eco` or `comfort`, set per room) or a number in °C – use a dot for half degrees (`21.5`). Without a 00:00 line, the last temperature carries over midnight.

Example:
```
00:00 eco
08:00 comfort
19:00 23
22:30 eco
```

data_description.schedule: One line per switch point, e.g. 08:00 comfort or 19:00 23.5 (dot for half degrees)
data_description.copy_to: Copy this day to other days.
data_description.use_default: Remove this room's override for the day (and the selected days) and follow the hub default again.

rules.title: Room-specific rules
rules.description:
Rules for this room only. They compete with the hub's global rules by priority: the highest-priority active rule wins.

{rules}

rule_add.title: Add rule
rule_add.description: Switch to a profile while the condition holds. When it ends, the base profile applies again. Unavailable entities never match.

data_description.entities: For example a person, an input boolean or a binary sensor.
data_description.match: Whether any or all entities must have the state.
data_description.operator: "is": any listed state matches. "is not": any state except the listed ones matches (e.g. every zone but home).
data_description.states: Pick or type states, e.g. home or not_home. Several values are allowed.
data_description.for_minutes: The condition must hold this long before the rule becomes active.
data_description.priority: Higher wins (across global and room rules).

rule_edit_form.description: Switch to a profile while the condition holds. When it ends, the base profile applies again. Unavailable entities never match.
